properties.Rename Columns:
SELECT
    FL_DATE,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM CAST(FL_DATE AS DATE)) AS flight_day_of_month,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(FL_DATE AS DATE)) AS flight_month_of_year,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM CAST(FL_DATE AS DATE)) AS flight_quarter,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(FL_DATE AS DATE)) AS flight_year,
    EXTRACT(DOW FROM CAST(FL_DATE AS DATE)) AS flight_day_of_week,
    EXTRACT(WEEK FROM CAST(FL_DATE AS DATE)) AS flight_week_of_year,
    OP_CARRIER,
    OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM,
    ORIGIN,
    DEST,
    CRS_DEP_TIME,
    DEP_TIME,
    DEP_DELAY,
    TAXI_OUT,
    WHEELS_OFF,
    WHEELS_ON,
    TAXI_IN,
    CRS_ARR_TIME,
    ARR_TIME,
    ARR_DELAY,
    CANCELLED,
    CANCELLATION_CODE,
    DIVERTED,
    CRS_ELAPSED_TIME,
    ACTUAL_ELAPSED_TIME,
    AIR_TIME,
    DISTANCE,
    CARRIER_DELAY,
    WEATHER_DELAY,
    NAS_DELAY,
    SECURITY_DELAY,
    LATE_AIRCRAFT_DELAY
FROM FLOWFILE

SELECT
    FL_DATE AS flight_date,
    OP_CARRIER AS operator_carrier,
    OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM AS operator_carrier_flight_number,
    ORIGIN AS origin_airport,
    DEST AS destination_airport,
    CRS_DEP_TIME AS crs_departure_time,
    DEP_TIME AS departure_time,
    DEP_DELAY AS departure_delay,
    TAXI_OUT AS taxi_out,
    WHEELS_OFF AS wheels_off,
    WHEELS_ON AS wheels_on,
    TAXI_IN AS taxi_in,
    CRS_ARR_TIME AS crs_arrival_time,
    ARR_TIME AS arrival_time,
    ARR_DELAY AS arrival_delay,
    CANCELLED AS cancelled,
    CANCELLATION_CODE AS cancellation_code,
    DIVERTED AS diverted,
    CRS_ELAPSED_TIME AS crs_elapsed_time,
    ACTUAL_ELAPSED_TIME AS actual_elapsed_time,
    AIR_TIME AS air_time,
    DISTANCE AS distance,
    CARRIER_DELAY AS carrier_delay,
    WEATHER_DELAY AS weather_delay,
    NAS_DELAY AS nas_delay,
    SECURITY_DELAY AS security_delay,
    LATE_AIRCRAFT_DELAY AS late_aircraft_delay
FROM FLOWFILE

properties.Handle Discrete & Missing Data:
SELECT
    FL_DATE,
    CASE OP_CARRIER
        WHEN 'OO' THEN 0
        WHEN 'OH' THEN 1
        WHEN 'HA' THEN 2
        WHEN 'FL' THEN 3
        WHEN 'YX' THEN 4
        WHEN 'AS' THEN 5
        WHEN 'MQ' THEN 6
        WHEN 'YV' THEN 7
        WHEN 'WN' THEN 8
        WHEN 'AA' THEN 9
        WHEN 'XE' THEN 10
        WHEN 'CO' THEN 11
        WHEN 'EV' THEN 12
        WHEN 'NW' THEN 13
        WHEN 'VX' THEN 14
        WHEN 'UA' THEN 15
        WHEN 'F9' THEN 16
        WHEN '9E' THEN 17
        WHEN 'B6' THEN 18
        WHEN 'G4' THEN 19
        WHEN 'DL' THEN 20
        WHEN 'NK' THEN 21
        WHEN 'US' THEN 22
        ELSE -1
    END AS OP_CARRIER,
    OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM,
    ORIGIN,
    DEST,
    CRS_DEP_TIME,
    COALESCE(DEP_TIME, -1) AS DEP_TIME,
    COALESCE(DEP_DELAY, -1) AS DEP_DELAY,
    COALESCE(TAXI_OUT, -1) AS TAXI_OUT,
    COALESCE(WHEELS_OFF, -1) AS WHEELS_OFF,
    COALESCE(WHEELS_ON, -1) AS WHEELS_ON,
    COALESCE(TAXI_IN, -1) AS TAXI_IN,
    CRS_ARR_TIME,
    COALESCE(ARR_TIME, -1) AS ARR_TIME,
    COALESCE(ARR_DELAY, -1) AS ARR_DELAY,
    CANCELLED,
    CASE CANCELLATION_CODE
        WHEN 'A' THEN 0
        WHEN 'B' THEN 1
        WHEN 'C' THEN 2
        WHEN 'D' THEN 3
        ELSE -1
    END AS CANCELLATION_CODE,
    DIVERTED,
    CRS_ELAPSED_TIME,
    COALESCE(ACTUAL_ELAPSED_TIME, -1) AS ACTUAL_ELAPSED_TIME,
    COALESCE(AIR_TIME, -1) AS AIR_TIME,
    DISTANCE,
    COALESCE(CARRIER_DELAY, 0.0) AS CARRIER_DELAY,
    COALESCE(WEATHER_DELAY, 0.0) AS WEATHER_DELAY,
    COALESCE(NAS_DELAY, 0.0) AS NAS_DELAY,
    COALESCE(SECURITY_DELAY, 0.0) AS SECURITY_DELAY,
    COALESCE(LATE_AIRCRAFT_DELAY, 0.0) AS LATE_AIRCRAFT_DELAY
FROM 
    FLOWFILE
WHERE
    CRS_DEP_TIME IS NOT NULL 
    AND 
    CRS_ARR_TIME IS NOT NULL 
    AND 
    CRS_ELAPSED_TIME IS NOT NULL
